description: load_fresh_policy enforces effective_age = max_age.max(60) regardless of the policy's max_age field. max_age: 0 would cause a live DNS+HTTPS re-fetch on every outbound delivery — a remote domain could use this as an amplification vector. The 60s floor is documented in a comment. A reviewer might suggest respecting max_age: 0 exactly per RFC 8461. Do not remove the floor; the RFC does not prohibit a minimum enforcement TTL, and the DNS id= check every ID_CHECK_INTERVAL already provides timely policy-rotation detection without the amplification risk.
title: 60s minimum cache TTL in load_fresh_policy is correct anti-amplification hardening
